# SCI-TEMPLATE_TO_SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1/r0.6

Status: frozen v0.1/r0.6 template-source scientific boundary; producer package
name remains generic until separately authorized

Producer: authorized template-response producer

Consumer: `SCI-FLT-MATCHED`

Selected human title: **Matched-template map amplitude estimation**. Title and
method ID are not optimality evidence; each realization carries its exact
`optimality_status`.

The producer supplies one immutable expected ordinary-MAP response per unit
amplitude from exact owner-authorized source-class, morphology, beam, or
physical-response authority. It binds identity/generation, amplitude
convention/units, source-domain reference, parent response quantity, CAL/BEAM
lineage, WCS/frame/anchor relation, sampling/translation/phase/ties, support,
validity, lifecycle, provenance, and finite query vocabulary.

The template shall not be learned, selected, centered, tuned, updated, or
reparameterized from target MAP payload, target-derived peaks/candidates, the
resulting amplitude field, target residuals, any NOI member, or post-selection
outcomes. A predeclared bank is allowed only when selection is independent of
target outcomes; target-inspected selection is a different inference method.

Materialized, structured, and exact lineage/query representations are
equivalent only when they preserve every scientific query. Missing scale,
phase, lineage, validity, or required query makes the dependent FLT route
unavailable. Exact-zero observed application dependence does not remove
template authority on an AO-001 construction domain. No detection, fit,
morphology inference, catalog, or SRC boundary is created.
